test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the tense used in the sentence:

"Instead, many people choose to suffer in silence."
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2** i.e '**Active voice**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the sentence, the subject **"many people"** is performing the action of the verb **"choose,"** which is the defining characteristic of the **Active voice**.
 
• The structure follows a standard **Subject + Verb + Object/Complement** pattern (People + choose + to suffer).
 
• The verb **"choose"** is in its base form, indicating that the focus is on the doer of the action rather than the action being done to the subject.
 
• Although the question asks for the "tense," the provided options refer to **Voice** (Active/Passive) and **Mood** (Imperative/Interrogative). Among these, Active voice is the only grammatically accurate description.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive voice: **In passive voice, the subject receives the action (e.g., "Suffering is chosen by many people"). This is not the case in the original sentence. 
 
• **Imperative voice:** This is a mood used for commands or requests (e.g., "Do not suffer in silence!").
 
• **Interrogative voice:** This refers to a sentence that asks a question (e.g., "Do many people choose to suffer in silence?").
